faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Buying, renting and listing on Pune's broker-free marketplace.
faq.a1: No. Draazy is completely broker-free. You contact property owners in Pune directly, so there is no brokerage or commission to pay.
faq.q2: How are owners and properties verified on Draazy?
faq.a2: An owner earns ID Verified Owner by photographing a government ID — Aadhaar, PAN or driving licence — with a live selfie, and a trained reviewer on our team decides the case. It is optional, so not every owner carries it. For Verified Property, Draazy checks an ownership document, the owner's government ID and photos of the property — it is not a search of the land registry. Many new projects also show their RERA registration.
faq.q3: Which areas of Pune does Draazy cover?
faq.a3: Draazy covers Baner, Wakad, Hinjawadi, Kothrud, Koregaon Park, Viman Nagar, Hadapsar, Wagholi, Kalyani Nagar, Kharadi and more — for buying, renting and flat-sharing.
faq.q4: Can I create a registered rent agreement online?
faq.a4: Yes. Fill in the details online and Draazy prepares your Maharashtra leave and licence agreement, handles stamp duty and e-registration, and arranges the biometric step at your doorstep.
faq.q5: What does an "Under Offer" property mean?
faq.a5: Under Offer means the owner is finalizing with an interested tenant or buyer but has not taken the token or signed the agreement yet. The listing stays live for backup enquiries until it is marked Rented or Sold.
